$description: System theme, dark appearance. Devot's own blue palette by default; Settings > Appearance can make the accent follow the macOS accent colour instead.

elevated.$description: What lifts off the page: sheet cards and the peek card.

text-faint.$description: A row's time on the plain list. Design #9b9ba1 light and #6e6e74 dark, moved until 4.5:1 on the page background.

bar.$description: The frosted band behind a top bar.

background.$description: The one page background, plain and grouped.

swipe-surface.$description: A row raised by a swipe.

flash.$description: The wash on a newly saved note's row.

lens.$description: The selected item's pill in a glass bar.

glass.$description: The tint of a floating glass control. Glass is for floating controls only, never content.

glass-highlight.$description: The inner highlight at the top left of a glass control.

glass-lowlight.$description: The inner highlight at the bottom right of a glass control.

glass-edge.$description: The 0.5 pt edge of a glass control.

glass-shadow.$description: The wide drop shadow under a glass control.

glass-shadow-near.$description: The close drop shadow under a glass control.

glass-glow.$description: The soft inner glow of a glass control.

glass-rim-a.$description: The bright end of a glass control's rim, at the top left.

glass-rim-b.$description: The other end of a glass control's rim, at the bottom right.

glass-sheen.$description: The radial sheen from the top left of a glass control.

glass-opaque.$description: What glass becomes under Reduce Transparency.

text-secondary.$description: Previews, captions and counts. Light: design #76767b, moved toward black until 4.5:1 on the card and the raised row.

section-head.$description: A section's title over the grouped background.

chevron.$description: A disclosure chevron and the sheet grabber: decoration on a row that says what it does, so no contrast pair.

dove.$description: The dove beside the Library title.

scrim.$description: The black a push, a peek or a sheet dims with, at opacity.phone-dim-*.

shadow.$description: The shadow a pushed screen casts to its left.

shadow-float.$description: The shadow under a peek card, a menu or a sheet.

on-action.$description: A glyph or count on a coloured action, a badge or the accent.

action-pin.$description: Pin. Design #ff9500, moved toward black until a white glyph has 3:1.

action-done.$description: Done. Dark: design #34c06a, moved toward black until a white glyph has 3:1.

badge.$description: A tab bar badge. Design #ff3b30, moved toward black until its white count has 4.5:1.

badge-ring.$description: The 2 pt ring around a badge, in the bar's colour.

destructive.$description: Text of a destructive row. Design #ff3b30, moved only as far as 4.5:1 on a card and a menu needs.

status-none.$description: The mark of a note with no status.

status-tile-active.$description: A chip or peek button for Active.

status-tile-hold.$description: A chip or peek button for On hold.

status-tile-done.$description: A chip or peek button for Completed.

status-tile-dropped.$description: A chip or peek button for Dropped.

keyboard.$description: Behind keys, in pictures of the keyboard; the app itself shows the system's.

key.$description: A letter key, in pictures of the keyboard.

key-alt.$description: A function key, in pictures of the keyboard.

ground.$description: Behind a QR code's modules: light in both appearances, since many scanners read only dark modules on a light ground.

module.$description: A QR code's dark modules, in both appearances.

sidebar.$description: The sidebar's wash over the window material.

sidebar-opaque.$description: The sidebar when the window material is turned off (Settings > Appearance), and the sidebar of the Settings window.

list-wash.$description: The note list's wash over the window material.

editor-wash.$description: The editor pane's wash over the window material.

window.$description: Behind every pane when the window material is turned off (Settings > Appearance).

popover.$description: Floating lists in the editor: the slash menu and the completion popups.

float-bar.$description: The floating bars over the editor (the selection toolbar, the image size bar) and their notch.

sheet.$description: Glass interface: the one wash the note list and the editor share over the window material, also the ring around the floating sidebar.

glass-tint.$description: Glass interface: the tint on the system's sidebar glass, so it sits one step above the sheet. Not measured on a device yet.

glass.$description: Glass interface: the floating sidebar's tint over the sheet where the system draws no glass of its own (before macOS 26).

glass-popover.$description: Glass interface: popovers, tooltips, pickers and dialogs, over a blur of what is under them.

glass-float-bar.$description: Glass interface: the floating bars over the editor and their notch, a little more solid than a popover so the notch, drawn without blur, matches.

text.$description: The one colour every text tier is drawn from: each color.text tier is this colour at its tier's strength over the editor (`tier` in its extensions), moved toward white only where contrast needs it.

line.$description: The one colour lines are drawn from: borders at 15% (light) or 10% (dark), internal dividers at 10%.

primary.$description: Page text: hsl(0 0% 98%) at 87% over the editor, opaque.

secondary.$description: Secondary text. Spec hsl(0 0% 98%) at 60% (#9a9a9a), lightened 9% toward white so it keeps 4.5:1 on the editor, the active line and the selection.

tertiary.$description: De-emphasised text: section labels, rules, fences, key hints in popups. Spec hsl(0 0% 98%) at 40% (#6a6a6a), lightened 26% toward white so it keeps 4.5:1 on every surface and the popover (3:1 on the selection).

destructive.$description: The label of a destructive action (Delete, Empty Trash).

placeholder.$description: Placeholder text in a field: the 40% tier, for placeholders and disabled text only; not held to text contrast.

hover.$description: Text under the pointer: the 80% tier, a little softer than body text.

selected.$description: Text of a selected or pressed item: the 95% tier.

disabled.$description: Text of a control that cannot be used: the 40% tier; not held to text contrast.

hairline.$description: Borders: pane dividers, field and button edges. The line ink at 10%.

separator.$description: Internal dividers: between note list rows, inside panels. The line ink at 10%.

match.$description: The outline of the current find match in a note.

control.$description: The outline ring of a floating toolbar button under the pointer.

shadow.$description: The soft shadow under floating panels.

float-bar.$description: A floating bar's outline: barely visible. The line ink at 10%.

glass-edge.$description: Glass interface: the thin edge of a glass panel or control.

glass-highlight.$description: Glass interface: the light along a glass panel's or control's top edge.

destructive.$description: Behind white text: the destructive action of a Glass alert. Darker than the status mark so its label keeps 4.5:1.

destructive-tile.$description: Glass interface: the tinted tile behind a destructive alert's icon.

scrollbar.$description: The thumb of a scroll bar.

match.$description: Behind words a search matched in the note list, and find matches in a note.

match-current.$description: Behind the current find match in a note (with `line.match` around it). Spec 50%, lowered to 45% so page text on it keeps 4.5:1.

completion-selected.$description: The selected row of a completion popup: a light violet.

settings-card.$description: A Settings card: a low-contrast step up from the pane behind it.

control.$description: A capsule control's fill in Settings: the search field, Back and Forward, pop-ups, buttons, segmented controls and steppers.

row-selected-inactive.$description: The selected Settings sidebar row while the window is not focused: a lighter neutral grey.

tool-hover.$description: A toolbar button under the pointer.

hover.$description: A menu or picker row under the pointer (separate from the keyboard highlight).

backdrop.$description: The dim behind a modal dialog.

glass-backdrop.$description: Glass interface: the dim behind a modal dialog, lighter in dark so the glass still reads as glass.

glass-control.$description: Glass interface: a toolbar button or segmented control floating over the sheet.

fill.$description: Behind white text: buttons, the focused list's selection. Spec #60a5fa, darkened so white text on it keeps 4.5:1.

text.$description: Accent text and links. Spec #5087ca, lightened 26% so it keeps 4.5:1 on every surface and the selection.

hover.$description: An accent control under the pointer.

selection.$description: Behind selected text in the focused editor: the caret colour (hsl(255 92% 76%)) at 20% over the editor, solid; the least that stands 1.3:1 from the editor and from the active line (spec 30%, lowered so the syntax colours lose less contrast).

selection-inactive.$description: Behind selected text when the editor does not have focus: the same tint at 13/30 of its strength.

completion-selected.$description: The selected item of a completion list or the slash menu.

code-fill.$description: Behind inline code, code blocks and tables in the editor.

code-border.$description: Around inline code, code blocks and tables in the editor.

authorship.$description: The authorship gutter's mark beside text an agent wrote (ADR 0007): Devot teal, the activity heatmap's strongest level, not the system accent. A graphic: 3:1 on the editor.

active-mark.$description: Status icons and dots: a mark, so 3:1 against the surfaces is enough and the colour stays vivid; status text keeps the darker colour.

hold-mark.$description: Status icons and dots: a mark, so 3:1 against the surfaces is enough and the colour stays vivid; status text keeps the darker colour.

done-mark.$description: Status icons and dots: a mark, so 3:1 against the surfaces is enough and the colour stays vivid; status text keeps the darker colour.

dropped.$description: Spec hsl(351 95% 71%), lightened 1% so status text keeps 4.5:1.

dropped-mark.$description: Status icons and dots: a mark, so 3:1 against the surfaces is enough and the colour stays vivid; status text keeps the darker colour.

note.$description: The note alert: its bar and its [!KIND] label. Spec hsl(217 91% 60%), lightened 17% toward white so it keeps 4.5:1 on the editor, the active line and the selection.

tip.$description: The tip alert: its bar and its [!KIND] label.

important.$description: The important alert: its bar and its [!KIND] label. Spec hsl(271 91% 65%), lightened 22% toward white so it keeps 4.5:1 on the editor, the active line and the selection.

warning.$description: The warning alert: its bar and its [!KIND] label.

caution.$description: The caution alert: its bar and its [!KIND] label. Spec hsl(0 84% 60%), lightened 23% toward white so it keeps 4.5:1 on the editor, the active line and the selection.

inserted.$description: Inserted text and literals in the editor: the string colour.

deleted.$description: Deleted text in the editor: the invalid colour.

heading.$description: Heading lines, and class names in code.

markup.$description: Markdown marks (`**`, `` ` ``, `#`, `[ ]`, fences, table pipes) and HTML tags.

list.$description: List marks at levels 1, 3, 5.... Spec hsl(239 84% 67%), lightened 26% toward white so it keeps 4.5:1 on the editor, the active line and the selection.

invalid.$description: Invalid code. Spec hsl(0 84% 60%), lightened 23% toward white so it keeps 4.5:1 on the editor, the active line and the selection.

class.$description: Class and type names in code: the heading colour.

added.$description: Background of a line added since a version (revision history).

removed.$description: Background of a line removed since a version (revision history).

series-1.$description: Chart series 1, blue. Series alternate deep and pale so neighbours differ in lightness, for colour-blind readers and greyscale print.

series-2.$description: Chart series 2, sand. Series alternate deep and pale so neighbours differ in lightness, for colour-blind readers and greyscale print.

series-3.$description: Chart series 3, plum. Series alternate deep and pale so neighbours differ in lightness, for colour-blind readers and greyscale print.

series-4.$description: Chart series 4, teal. Series alternate deep and pale so neighbours differ in lightness, for colour-blind readers and greyscale print.

series-5.$description: Chart series 5, clay. Series alternate deep and pale so neighbours differ in lightness, for colour-blind readers and greyscale print.

series-6.$description: Chart series 6, sage. Series alternate deep and pale so neighbours differ in lightness, for colour-blind readers and greyscale print.

on-series.$description: Text on a chart series: 4.5:1 on all six.

on-bar.$description: Text on a gantt bar: 4.5:1 on all three.

level-0.$description: An idle day in the activity heatmap.

level-1.$description: A day with the least writing in the activity heatmap.

level-2.$description: A day with some writing in the activity heatmap.

level-3.$description: A day with more writing in the activity heatmap.

level-4.$description: A day with the most writing in the activity heatmap.

bg.$description: A fenced code block's box in the editor; translucent so the selection shows through.

number.$description: The line numbers beside a code block in the preview.

bg.$description: The header bar of a code block with a language or a file name.

head.$description: A table's header row in the preview.

stripe.$description: Every other body row of a table in the preview.

bar.$description: The left bar of a blockquote in the preview.

bg.$description: The box behind a word a filter matched in the note list.

border.$description: The outline of that box, a shade darker.

trailing-space.$description: Behind spaces and tabs at the end of a line when the editor highlights trailing whitespace.

popover-key.$description: The close, sharp layer of a pop-up's shadow.

popover-ambient.$description: The wide, soft layer of a pop-up's shadow.

float-bar.$description: The soft shadow under a floating bar.

glass.$description: Glass interface: the soft shadow under the floating sidebar and the toolbar controls.

ring.$description: The focus ring on custom controls (2 px, offset 0): the accent fill. Design value 30%, raised to 97% so the ring keeps 3:1 on every surface.

tag-text.$description: A tag chip's label: its tag colour moved toward white only as far as 4.5:1 on the chip needs (contrast.test.ts).

tag-icon.$description: A notebook icon in a tag colour: the tag colour, moved toward black only as far as 3:1 on the sidebar, lists, editor and popovers needs (contrast.test.ts).

handle.$description: The knob of an on/off switch, on its lane in either state.
